project: Rudolf Blaschka America 1892 — transport, reference media, split workshop, selective reactivation and receiving reconstruction
current_thesis: The 1892 journey intervened in an already distributed Harvard–Hosterwitz reference-supply ecology. Travel relocated part of reference selection into the maker's presence, but field productivity remained governed by season, bodily/time capacity and Harvard's existing collection: Cambridge could make a locally available plant redundant before it became a retained reference. Selected plants were assigned to different media whose temporal capacities differed. Drawings stabilized completed observations; dried/alcohol material preserved selected structures; seeds, bulbs and live plants could transport future observability; deferred local supply and cultivated institutions repaired phenological or geographic inaccessibility. These references moved asynchronously through caches and relays, and only some were later reactivated in glass. Finished models then underwent another sequence of state changes as freight, customs-controlled assemblages, unpacked/remounted museum objects and sometimes destabilized exhibition objects. Transport redistributed work in space, time, media and authority by repeatedly changing what counted as the useful, movable or observable object.

new_after_pass28.result: BLA-D00879 proves collection-aware field filtering: Rudolf says Cambridge does not want some species because they are already represented. Harvard's existing collection therefore acts as a remote negative selector upstream of return. Named rejected taxa remain unrecovered.

Formal denominator guard added. The nine-sheet Tempe packet is a minimum discovered micro-packet, while Harvard's >300 specimen statement combines 1892 and 1895. Selective conversion is an event-level mechanism, not a measured 1/9 or expedition-wide rate.

Deferred access split by fulfillment status: Crinum/Orcutt = later supply actually received in Cambridge; Sequoia = planned later flowering-material supply with no dispatch/receipt yet; Darlingtonia = cultivated institutional substitution after route rejection.

negative_evidence_rules: Do not infer named Cambridge rejections from later model absence; BLA-D00879 proves a mechanism, not a taxon list.
No HUH search hit is not historical specimen absence.
No exact model-list species string is not proof of no glass descendant; historical synonymy and labels must be checked.
Same genus is not a descendant relationship.
Specimen/model metadata alignment does not prove the surviving sheet was the sole workshop template.
Harvard's >300 specimens combines 1892 and 1895 and is not an 1892 denominator.
Do not use 1/9 or any current packet count as a conversion rate.
A promised later supply is not a dispatched, received, survived or modelled supply.
quantitative_rules: Never use a single expedition 'species collected' total.
Attach each number to actor, date, medium/operation and status.
Treat Colorado 200 and projected 400 as already conditioned by season, collection-state filtering and work capacity.
Preserve Jamaica ~100/106/116 separately as forecast/self-count/institutional drawing ledger.
Preserve Rudolf ~3-year and Goodale actor-specific future-work estimates separately until original Goodale letters are closed.
Packet quantities remain separate from species-study, herbarium-sheet and model-output counts.
